title: Win Technical Sales Calls with a Product Expert
summary: Answer deep product questions live and know how you compare, so calls do not stall on "let me get back to you".

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes technical deals often stall on open questions; it helps calls move, it does not create demand.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Fewer deals slip while you wait for an engineer.
Competitive context helps you handle objections.
who_its_for: Founders and sales teams selling technical products.

stack.name: Product Expert
stack.role: Answers product questions from your code or knowledge base.
stack.creator: kristaletz

steps.name: Product Expert
steps.does: Answers product questions from your sources

steps: Connect the knowledge source the Product Expert should read.
Test it on the ten questions buyers ask most.
Set Scout to send a weekly competitor brief.
Use both before and during calls.
guardrails: Check answers about pricing and roadmap before you share them.
